name: PDF Filler
tagline: Reads your email threads and fills any PDF form, even scanned ones, then checks its own work visually.
problem: People spend hours each week copying details from emails into PDF forms.
solution: Detects field positions, extracts details from email context, fills the form and uses a vision model on screenshots of the result to verify and correct placement.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop in a form and watch it fill from your inbox.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 124 submissions.
Talked to people who fill forms all week.
A visual feedback loop checks the output.

lessons: Let the model check its own output with a different sense (vision).
